description: The estate's base-image rule, plus Playwright as one group: the gate's image ships the Chromium one playwright release drives, the image installs that release globally, the sidecar imports it, and CI provisions the browser specs/ resolves, so all four move in one PR or the gate launches no browser.
npm runs for playwright alone; every other dependency stays the owner's to move.

customManagers.description: The playwright the gate image installs globally beside its base's Chromium.
